scope: Risk assessment, not exhaustive discovery closure; previous phase fields remain historical.

rules.critical: Parser/scanner/token/precedence changes or compiler checks, writable/reference contexts, declarations and constant-expression traversal capable of changing source acceptance. Requires direct review.
rules.elevated: AST, linking, inheritance, attributes, enum and optimizer changes, plus unassociated test deltas pending source association. No automatic exclusion.
rules.low: Demonstrably mechanical C edits or reviewed harness/runtime/API deltas without a source-acceptance mechanism. Exclusion is limited to the documented delta, not whole-file correctness.

upstream.purpose: Reduce similar TMP/VAR handlers and dereference overhead; preserve references in write contexts. PR description does not authorize new assignment-based writable targets.

php86014.determination: Source-level operand mismatch accounts for observed invalid opcode 23/2/1. This is evidence of a compiler/VM inconsistency, not proof of intended syntax. Reference assignment uses a distinct supported operand path; successful execution does not prove language intent.
php86014.provenance: No exact-pin build was produced. Existing Windows RC4 and PHP 8.5.10 limitations remain.

blockers.phase3: Not independently blocking an unchanged baseline once discovery is adequate.
blockers.final: Blocks certification of this area until intended behavior and exact-pin observations reconcile.

php86015.finding: New printf specialization evaluates argument ASTs before ordinary expression compilation. Both newly rejected and newly accepted discarded unset-cast forms observed; no new terminal or EBNF edit justified.

blockers.phase4: Blocks blanket optimizer no-impact disposition and unverified traversal rules.
blockers.final: Requires appropriate interpreter/source correspondence and version-boundary evidence.

phptWindowsEvidence.sourceReason: run-tests.php:2331-2414 executes SKIPIF separately and interprets skip output as eligibility. util.inc old helpers gate Windows/iconv/codepage; new helpers call sapi_windows_cp_get/set directly and extract basename formatting. util_utf8.inc is byte-identical, generates filenames/data and one fixed echo include. bug75063 generated bodies are unchanged filesystem loops, not generated new syntax. FILE/INI/EXPECT deltas are absent from these exact groups.
phptWindowsEvidence.dependencyReview: Scanned dependency/generation references in both sides of all 82 members; reviewed util.inc on both sides, full unchanged util_utf8.inc, and both bug75063 generated-code representatives. No upstream programs executed.
phptWindowsEvidence.limitation: This does not exclude other Windows filesystem changes or certify scanner encoding behavior. Existing scanner/state conformance obligations remain.

phase3.reason: Material compiler/optimizer/linking discovery gaps remain; PHP86-014 alone is bounded and API certification is not a prerequisite.

phase4.reason: Complete implementation not ready; verified edits retain evidence, but assignment-based write rules and contextual traversal interactions remain blocked.

finalCertification.reason: RC4 only; no 8.6 package/validation, exact-pin executable limitations and unresolved discovery/contextual discrepancies.

sourceCoverage.parserScanner: Prior full diff review retained; state/error regression and final-release review remain.
sourceCoverage.compilerLedger: 578 raw hunks in eight files; phase22 classifications are not complete direct review.
sourceCoverage.outsideLedger: Core/optimizer source association incomplete; no blanket low-risk exclusion.
